premise: I drained my $88,000 403(b) to co-sign a lease on a six-seat Cessna and start a scenic flight business with my brother, who promised me half the bookings and a life-estate hangar office, but he forged a document making me only a guarantor, sold the FAA flight certificate and the aircraft for $400,000, and stuck me with the lease debt; I found the original handshake contract video-recorded at our mother's 90th birthday, sued for conversion, won a $320,000 judgment plus the repossessed plane, and now operate 'Sky Justice Air Tours' – my brother must scrub the lavatory and wear a cap that says 'Flight Risk' while every boarding pass prints his fraud case number.
